performance.verdict: Spend is live but leads are zero — tracking disconnect masks true CPL.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $1,015.39 spent over 28 days, 0 leads in CRM across all 28 series days — Google's 11 conversions never reach GHL.
Intake owner milestone overdue since 2026-08-31: Vivian left 7/7, GHL seat may be empty, blocking speed-to-lead and budget scale-up.
5 additional SOW milestones overdue (Booking bot 7/31, Review Boost, Financing page, Homer Glen branch 8/31, LSA re-enable 9/1) — all stalled.
GBP actions collapsed -97.5% week-over-week to 0 in last 5 days (vs. peak of 17 on 2026-08-19) — organic visibility has gone dark.
Google spend volatile but trending up: last 3 days averaged $20.86/day vs prior 3-day avg of $77.55 — spend erratic, no stable signal.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads → GHL conversion path immediately; 11 platform conversions vs 0 CRM leads over 28 days confirms a broken handoff.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 11 conversions over the 28-day window but GHL shows 0 leads captured across every day in the series — the conversion event fires but leads never land in the CRM. Audit the webhook or form submission path between Google Ads (LSA + search) and GHL this week. Success means at least 1 new lead appears in GHL within 48 hours of a confirmed Google click. Resolve by 2026-09-10 before any budget change is considered.

suggestions.text: Confirm named intake owner with active GHL login before 2026-09-10; scale-up gate remains hard-blocked per SOW until resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left on 7/7 and no replacement intake owner has been confirmed per the 8/31 SOW milestone. Speed-to-lead automations are pointing at an empty seat, which compounds the lead capture failure. Contact Xavier or Nader to name the replacement and verify their GHL login is active. Success check: named owner confirmed in writing and GHL login tested by 2026-09-10.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery over next 3 days; zero actions for 5 straight days after a 17-action peak on 2026-08-19 warrants escalation if still dark.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for the last 5 consecutive days (2026-09-01 through 2026-09-05), down from a peak of 17 on 2026-08-19 and a -97.5% weekly delta. Note the SOW flag about Windsor data lag in the last 2–3 days of any GBP window — confirm whether this is a data lag artifact or a real drop. Re-check on 2026-09-09; if still at zero and data lag is ruled out, escalate as an organic visibility issue.
